description: This file defines the IntegerDistribution interface, specifying methods for probability mass function, cumulative distribution function, quantile function, and support bounds for distributions over integers in the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: IntegerDistribution
classes.description: Interface for integer-valued probability distributions, providing methods for calculating probabilities, quantiles, and distribution bounds.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Returns the probability mass function value P(X = x) at a given integer x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Returns the cumulative probability P(X <= x) at a given integer x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Returns the probability P(x0 < X <= x1) between two integer bounds, inclusive of the upper bound, exclusive of the lower.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the smallest integer x such that P(X <= x) >= p, representing the p-quantile.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution, or NaN if undefined.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution, or NaN or infinity if undefined.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution support.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution support.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether all integers between support bounds are included.

methods.name: reseedRandomGenerator
methods.description: Reseeds the random number generator used for sampling.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the distribution.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates an array of random samples of specified size.
